description: This file defines a WorkManager worker class 'NotesSyncWorker' that handles synchronizing notes in an Android application. The worker performs a sync operation when invoked, utilizing the app's repository to synchronize data, and employs try-catch for error handling. It is designed to work with both periodic and one-off sync tasks.

classes.name: NotesSyncWorker
classes.description: A Worker class for synchronizing notes, runs in background, handles sync logic, and manages retry policies.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Performs the actual synchronization task, calling the app's repository to sync notes and handling exceptions to determine the result.
